name: mobywatel-prototype
description: Clickable PWA prototype of a new mObywatel app for the mobywatel.ai challenge (unofficial, fictional data).

scripts.test: turbo run test:unit && pnpm run test:tools
scripts.ci:quality: pnpm run format && turbo run lint typecheck test:unit build && pnpm run test:tools && pnpm run audit:harness && pnpm run audit:guardrails
scripts.cache:clean: rm -rf node_modules apps/*/node_modules packages/*/node_modules .turbo apps/*/.turbo packages/*/.turbo apps/*/dist && echo 'Caches cleared. Run pnpm install.'
